excerpts.text: | United Arab Emirates at the 2026 Winter Olympics |

The [United Arab Emirates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates "United Arab Emirates") competed at the [2026 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Winter_Olympics "2026 Winter Olympics") in [Milan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Milan "Milan") and [Cortina d'Ampezzo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cortina_d'Ampezzo "Cortina d'Ampezzo"), Italy, which was held from 6 to 22 February 2026. This was the country's first time participating in the Winter Olympics.

The United Arab Emirates team consisted of two alpine skiers (one per gender), [Alexander Astridge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexander_Astridge "Alexander Astridge") and [Piera Hudson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Piera_Hudson "Piera Hudson").[[1]](#cite_note-1)[[2]](#cite_note-2)[[3]](#cite_note-3) The pair were also the country's flagbearer during the [closing ceremony](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Winter_Olympics_closing_ceremony "2026 Winter Olympics closing ceremony").[[4]](#cite_note-4)[[5]](#cite_note-5)
